title: ISO 14743:2020 — Pneumatic fluid power — Push-in connectors for thermoplastic tubes
locator: Official abstract: general requirements and test methods for design and performance of push-in connectors for thermoplastic tubes with the specified outside-diameter range; tests complete connector assemblies; excludes air braking systems.
notes: Applies to push-in connector assemblies within the specified scope, not to every pneumatic tube material or air-brake application. Tube/connector compatibility still requires product-family evidence.
